habitat: Meadows, roadsides and gardens with milkweed
season: Spring to fall in temperate North America
identification: Orange wings with dark veins and black, white-spotted borders.
fact: Some North American monarch populations migrate thousands of miles.
form: Representative form; individual colors and markings vary
